Can damage dealt by Carrion Crows be "tasted"? What about Blood of Acid or
superior Drawing out the Beast's damage?

If Nakova advocate of golconda is blocked with a Dawn OP and gets burnt, is
the resulting damage from her ability aggravated as well?

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <6gn2h1$mp2$1...@nnrp1.dejanews.com>, <ste...@sympatico.ca> wrote:
>Can damage dealt by Carrion Crows be "tasted"?

Yep.

>What about Blood of Acid or

Sure.

>superior Drawing out the Beast's damage?

As the damage occurs after each round (after the strike resolution phase),
you cannot benefit from Taste.

>If Nakova advocate of golconda is blocked with a Dawn OP and gets burnt, is
>the resulting damage from her ability aggravated as well?

Sure is. There was a spate of Nakova/Bomb/DawnOp decks for a while after
she came out.

gomi
